description:
Set on a private site of approximately one acre, this impressive five-bedroom detached family home offers an excellent accommodation, mature landscaped gardens and peaceful countryside living. Enjoying a secluded setting with mature hedging and established hardwood trees, the property provides excellent privacy while remaining conveniently positioned for access to the town and the N4 and N52 road networks.

The accommodation opens with a spacious entrance hall finished with tiled flooring. From here, the property offers two separate reception rooms. The main living room features solid timber flooring and an open fireplace, while the other sitting room, also finished with solid timber flooring, provides an ideal second family room/ playroom/bedroom. The kitchen is fitted with wall and floor units together with a cooker and hob and tiled flooring, solid fuel stove and patio doors open directly onto the rear garden. The ground floor also includes a spacious double bedroom finished with solid timber flooring. A guest WC with a shower cubicle and electric shower completes the ground-floor accommodation.

Upstairs, there are three further generously proportioned bedrooms. One benefits from ample storage and a private en-suite shower room, while another particularly spacious bedroom offers both fitted wardrobes and additional storage. The family bathroom is a four-piece suite.

Externally, the property is surrounded by impressive mature gardens extending to approximately one acre. Established hedging and mature hardwood trees add character and create an attractive countryside setting, with both timber and a steel shed. A gravel driveway provides ample off-street parking.

The property is conveniently located approximately five minutes from Mullingar, providing easy access to an extensive selection of primary and secondary schools, and all necessary and social amenities. The nearby N4 and N52 provide excellent connectivity for commuters and convenient access to the wider Midlands and Dublin road networks.

Viewing is highly recommended.
